==Hero Usage==
* Heroes do not prioritize martial, attacking, or closely packed foes when using this spell. They ''will'' switch targets in most cases to avoid prematurely ending this skill (see discussion):
** When attacked alone by enemies.
** When engaging as a result of the player attacking.
** After being ordered to perform Glimmering Mark before combat.
** When locked onto a target, in which case Glimmering Mark is cast on another enemy.

== Notes ==
* Only skills which directly target the foe cause Glimmering Mark to end; the hex is unaffected by skills that might impact the target through [[area of effect]].
* Blindness is applied before the attack skill hits.
* Blindness is applied if an attack skill is being [[Activation time|activated]] when Glimmering Mark does damage. Carefully [[Attack speed|timed]] or quick attack skills can be activated between two damage [[packet]]s of Glimmering Mark, avoiding the Blindness effect.
{{Bug|The concise description fails to specify the duration of the Blind condition}}
{{anomaly|Unlike most [[area damage over time]] skills, Glimmering Mark does not cause [[AI]] to [[scatter]].}}
